general.title: A Targeted Tax Cut May Do Little to Fix Britain’s Youth Crisis
general.summary: The UK’s attempts to overcome its youth unemployment crisis have landed on a straightforward idea: lower payroll tax on young workers. Economists worry it won’t be that simple, however, given unpromising evidence from other European countries.

Thai Exports Surge as Imports Drive Trade Deficit to Record High
general.summary: Thailand’s exports grew at the fastest pace in more than five years in October, but an even bigger surge in imports pushed the country’s trade deficit to a record.

general.title: Philippine Trade Deficit Hits Record as Imports Soar 50%
general.summary: The Philippines posted a record trade deficit in October as a 50% surge in imports outpaced another sharp rise in exports.

general.title: SoftBank Group’s ¥1 Trillion Retail Bond Shows More Credit Risk
general.summary: SoftBank Group Corp.’s rising credit risk is starting to show up in its ¥1 trillion ($6.3 billion) retail bond, which had remained relatively resilient even as its overseas bond spreads widened sharply.

general.title: Foreign Funds on Pace for Record Taiwan Stock Exodus in AI Rout
general.summary: Foreign investors dumped a record amount of Taiwanese stocks so far in November, underscoring how heavily the global AI bellwether has been battered by the pullback in tech shares.

general.title: Copper Surges the Most in 10 Months as Risk Appetite Returns
general.summary: Copper surged the most since January, extending its rebound from an 11-month low alongside global equities, as risk appetite returned after weeks of volatility fueled by concerns over the AI trade.
